Original QEMU archive retains bundled firmware bytes/notices; additional firmware archives and unresolved source/build matches remain in compliance/firmware. This package does not close those gaps.
No byte-identical recreation claimed; corresponding-source obligations must be assessed under the applicable licenses, not a universal identical-binary rule.
Main exporter must retain allowlist additions and referenced build/overlay inputs; generating this manifest does not change the exporter.
